description:
You find yourself in a kitchen. A standard one.

You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a fridge. You make out a closed oven here. You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than a table. The table is massive. But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of trash. Oh, great. Here's a counter. The counter is vast. On the counter you can see a raw yellow potato, a banana, a red hot pepper, a cookbook and a knife. You scan the room, seeing a stove! The stove is conventional.
